## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Adan Phu_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I transferred my money to Robinhood, bought some stocks, then sold them. I was trying to transfer all my money to Webull after my money was settled. Robinhood restricted my account. I am unable to trade, nor contact support. I don’t feel safe at all. Very sketchy. What if you lock my account, make non-sense, gaslit, and ridiculous excuses, then steal my money away forever. What if prices are so fine now, but I couldn’t trade then all opportunities will be gone by the time the account is done being reviewed. This is beyond strange, and ridiculous. Not only that, the app was so buggy that it took me into a buggy loop. Couldn’t upload documents, connect with my bank account through Plaid, and so on. I don’t feel safe at all. I don’t feel safe anymore."
            2. _D.O.Double_, Jul 24, 2026, 5/5: "Most important of said-tweaks is the inability to customize the time intervals given in the advanced charting process. I do quick options trades all the time and when I look at the advanced charts, the default time interval given is “5 YEARS.” For those who aren’t familiar w/ options, 5 years is the absolute LAST time interval anyone would ever use, period. But there’s no way to change this default of 5-years permanently. So imagine how many times I - and COUNTLESS OTHERS - have to change the entire chart from 5-years worth of advanced trading data, down to today’s, at 30 secs per interval. Or lower. I HOPE someone reading this can understand the brevity of this situation, in that, it needs changing immediately. Because if I’m having troubles, I guarantee THOUSANDS more are having exactly the same issue."
